load.partyOnly: Only the parties to this deal can view it.

payment.s: Paid directly between parties — you only report that payment was made (INV-11)

confirm.s: Each party must confirm to proceed (INV-4)

shell.amountPending: Shown once both parties agree in the contract

confirm.title: Confirm deal
confirm.sub: The deal is confirmed only when both the referred party and the partner confirm (INV-4). One side alone cannot move it forward.
confirm.autoNote: The deal is confirmed automatically if there is no response for 7 days. You can withdraw your confirmation only until the other party confirms.
confirm.allDone: Both parties have confirmed — you can request settlement (INV-3).
confirm.notReady: Settlement cannot be requested yet. It opens once both parties confirm — currently {n}/2.
confirm.settleTitle: Settlement can be requested only after both parties confirm (INV-4).

contract.title: Contract · Deal confirmation
contract.sub: Both parties confirm the contract terms here. SogaeBank is an intermediary platform and not a party to the deal.
contract.payValue: Directly between parties — the platform does not hold or relay funds (INV-11)
contract.disputeValue: Dispute filed via Help Center → settlement on hold → mediation by SogaeBank (dispute mediation guide)
contract.feeNote: Referral fees are not calculated from a rate table (A-12). The amount above was agreed between the parties, and the platform is not involved in setting it. Changing it after confirmation requires both parties to confirm again.
contract.issueNote: Issuing the contract locks the agreed referral fee. Later changes require a reason and renewed consent from both parties.
contract.downloadTitle: Available once the contract is issued
contract.downloadHint: Available once the contract is issued{issued}.

pay.title: Payment
pay.sub: Payment is made directly between the parties. The platform does not hold or relay funds — here you only report that payment was made (INV-11).
pay.note: The platform does not hold funds. Payment reports serve as evidence for deal confirmation and disputes — no amounts or account numbers are collected.
pay.skipNote: Some sections let you skip this step. For deals without a contract, each party simply confirms in the deal confirmation step.

review.title: Write a review
review.lead: Referrer grades are based on reviews and acceptance rate, not volume. An honest review helps the next person.
review.introOnly: Referrers cannot review their own deals.
review.confirmedOnly: You can review only confirmed deals.
review.empty: Pick at least one tag or write 10 or more characters.
review.noDelete: Reviews can be edited but not deleted. They form the basis of the other party’s grade. False content is handled through reports.
review.noContact: Do not include contact details or account numbers. Reviews are public — such details are filtered automatically.

cp.issued: Issued {at} · The amount is now locked.
cp.both: Both parties signed — the deal is confirmed and settlement has been requested.
cp.notice: The second signature confirms the deal. Settlement is then requested automatically and cannot be undone.

dc.ask: Confirm that this deal has closed? Once the other party also confirms, it is final and cannot be undone.

dispute.title: File a dispute
dispute.noDeals: There are no deals you can dispute.
dispute.max: You can attach up to 3 files.
dispute.done: Received{no}. Settlement for this deal is on hold. We will notify you when it is resolved.
dispute.bodyPh: Describe in date order what differed from the agreement. Do not include contact details or account numbers.
dispute.attachTitle: Contract · chat · photos — images or PDF, up to 3 files, 10MB each
dispute.pageSub: File issues you cannot resolve with the other party. SogaeBank is not a party to the deal; it helps with records and procedures — payment is made between the parties.
dispute.empty: You have not filed any disputes. Once filed, you can track their status in this table.
dispute.holdDefault: Settlement is automatically put on hold for disputed deals.
dispute.holdTail: The hold is lifted once the case is closed (resolved or rejected).
dispute.outside: If no agreement is reached, we connect you to the external mediation bodies listed under “Dispute mediation” in the footer. SogaeBank does not judge who is right.

reasons.unreachable: Unreachable — no number or no answer
reasons.falseInfo: False information — request does not match reality
reasons.duplicate: Duplicate lead — same request already received
reasons.outOfScope: Out of area/field — region or category not enabled

fee.short: Describe what was inaccurate in at least 5 characters.
fee.failRetry: Could not submit the request. Please try again shortly.
fee.empty: No fees are currently eligible for rejection (within 72 hours of lead receipt · once per lead).
fee.whatPh: e.g. The number provided is not in service. Tried calling 3 times
fee.hint: A failed consultation is not grounds for rejection. Only defects in the lead itself are accepted.

payReport.closed: Reported. This deal is already confirmed, so there is nothing more to do — leaving a review helps other members.
payReport.open: Reported. Next is deal confirmation — the deal closes once both sides confirm.
payReport.memoNote: Do not enter amounts or account numbers — the platform does not store them

report.title: Report
report.lead: Tell us what is wrong with this {label}. We will let you know the outcome after review.
report.idv: Identity verification required. Anonymous reports could let competitors file repeated reports from new accounts, so only verified members can report.
report.noReasons: Could not load report reasons. Please try again shortly.
report.idvDone: Identity verification required. Anonymous reports could let competitors file repeated reports from new accounts, so only verified members can report — your account is verified.
report.hide3: {what} hidden once 3 different members report it. It is not deleted; our team reviews it and either restores or removes it (v10.27 · G-191).
report.notAlone: Reports alone do not take a post down. Our team reviews them once similar reports accumulate — this prevents groups from taking down others’ posts.
report.self: You cannot report your own post.
report.selfPost: To take it down, use Delete on the post page.
report.selfOther: To take it down, use "Take down" in <link>My listings</link> to make it private.
report.errSelf: You cannot report your own post.
report.errFail: Could not submit. Please try again shortly.
report.phRequired: Describe the problem. We cannot process the report without it.
report.phOptional: Specific details help us process it faster.
report.hint: Repeated false reports may restrict your reporting privileges.

payMethod.removeAsk:

payMethod.regFail: Could not register. Please try again shortly.
payMethod.removeFail: Could not delete. Settle any unpaid charges first.
payMethod.cardSub: Back from the card company window — finishing registration
payMethod.cardOk: Your card is registered. Future charges will use this card.
payMethod.cardBad: This return address does not match. Please register again from Payment methods.
payMethod.cardFail: Card registration was not completed (cancelled or declined by the card company). Please try again.

archive.ask: Take down “{title}”? It will be removed from lists and search.

invite.title: Please review this referral request
invite.lead: You can review it even if you are not a SogaeBank member. Nothing happens unless you agree.
invite.valid: {n, plural, one {{n} valid connection} other {{n} valid connections}}

effects.chat: A chat opens with the requester
effects.own: Only information you enter yourself is shared
effects.log: Your consent and its time are recorded
effects.stop: You can leave the chat at any time

invite.contact: The requester does not currently know your contact details. A chat opens only after you agree, and even then only the contact details you enter yourself are shared.
invite.noPenalty: Declining has no consequences. The referrer is only told that you declined, and no reason is asked. If you do not respond, it expires automatically at {until}.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the referrer to send it again.
invite.declined: You have already declined this invitation.
invite.foot: This link is valid until {until}. SogaeBank is an intermediary platform and not a party to any deal.
invite.declineAsk: Decline this referral? The referrer will only be told that you declined.
invite.fail: Could not complete the request. Please try again shortly.
invite.cut: Connection lost. Please try again shortly.
invite.consented: You have already agreed. If you are logged in, the button below opens the chat with the requester.
invite.note: Agreeing opens a chat. Your consent is recorded. If you decline, no reason is shared with {name}.

chat.idRequired: Only identity-verified members can open a deal.
chat.dealFailRetry: Could not open the deal. Please try again shortly.
chat.hint: The platform provides only the contract template and is not a party to the contract. Opening a deal records the referral history.
chat.startFirst: Send an inquiry first to start the conversation.
chat.kept: Chats are kept as evidence for dispute mediation
chat.emptyLong: Send your first inquiry. The conversation starts with your first message.
chat.warnTitle: ⚠ Please review this message before sending
chat.warnBody: Detected: {list}. Dealing outside the platform counts as avoiding the referral fee, and if problems arise you will not be covered by dispute mediation or settlement protection.
chat.attachTip: You can upload images or PDFs up to 10MB. Available once chat attachment storage is connected.
chat.foot: Attachments: images or PDFs up to 10MB. Chats are kept as evidence for dispute mediation.
chat.attrTip: Credited to the first referral code used, for a set period (first-touch).
chat.payTo: If this deal closes, the referral fee goes to {name}. It will not change even if you come back via another referral code.
chat.noAttr: No referral code is attached to this inquiry — the deal proceeds without a referrer.
chat.feeNote: Referral fees are not calculated from a rate table — the parties agree on the fee in the chat and write it into the contract.
chat.needId: You can request a contract (open a deal) after identity verification. Verify identity
chat.formOnly: The platform provides only the contract template and is not a party to the contract.
chat.ownBody: You cannot inquire about your own listing. Reply to inquiries on this listing in <link>My page → Received inquiries</link>.

bot.hello: Hello, this is SogaeBank. How can we help?

quick.fee: How much is the referral fee?
quick.settle: When will I receive my settlement?
quick.attr: When does a referral code get the credit?
quick.trust: What is the referral trust score?

bot.handReply: Shall we pass you to an agent? Press “Talk to a support agent” below and this conversation will be attached as is.
bot.missReply: We could not find an exact answer. Try rephrasing, or pass it to an agent.
bot.emailNeed: Please enter an email for the reply.
bot.handFail: Could not pass to an agent. Please try again shortly.
bot.handed:
Passed to an agent. Ticket no. {no}. {sla} The conversation so far is attached, so you do not need to explain again.

Support hours — {open} (except lunch {lunch})
bot.emailHint: You are not logged in — the agent will reply to this email.
bot.rule: The chatbot answers only what rules and documents can answer. Matters that need human judgment, such as amounts, accounts and disputes, go to an agent.

hours.sla: Inquiries during business hours are answered within 2 hours; others by the next business morning.

support.title: 1:1 inquiry
support.lead: The chatbot answers first, and matters needing human judgment go to an agent.
support.disputeFoot: Deal disputes are handled separately via <link>File a dispute</link> — filing puts settlement for that deal on hold.
support.newLead: Check the FAQ first. If you cannot find an answer, contact us below and we will reply within 1 business day.
support.botBody: The chatbot instantly answers rule-based questions like referral fees, settlement and referral credit. Amounts, accounts and disputes go to an agent.
support.payDay: Settlement and payout inquiries peak around the weekly Wednesday payout day.
support.newFoot: Before a deal, read the <guide>fraud prevention guide</guide>. <hist>My inquiries</hist>
support.doneDueDefault: We will reply within 1 business day.
support.doneMail: The reply will be sent to your registered email.
support.late:
If the reply is delayed

Business verification and settlement inquiries may take longer to check. Dispute mediation must be filed via disputes, not here, to put settlement on hold.
support.histLead: See answers from both the chatbot and agents.

tpl.title: Contract template
tpl.sub: Clauses cannot be changed; only the blanks are filled in.
tpl.subFull: {name} {version} — clauses cannot be changed; only the blanks are filled in.{eff}

tpl.same: This is the same text as the actual contract. The contract you sign is generated from this version ({code} {version}), and the screen shows that text as is.
